subject: Request: SKU banding & volume override for Equinox Data
messages:
From: Peter Lowe <peter@equinoxdata.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-02T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing inquiry — expected spend profile & commit options

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking the time to chat earlier. Following up with the usage profile we discussed: Equinox expects a ramp to ~1.2B generation tokens/month and ~400M embedding tokens within 6 months if the POC goes well. Main ask: clear pricing for per-token hosted API with commit tiers (monthly/annual), and whether you can create a custom SKU band for predictable unit pricing.

Key questions:
- What per-token rate would you consider for a committed 1B+ generation token tier?
- Can we get a time-limited below-rate-card concession while we ramp (first 3–6 months)?
- Any constraints on concurrency or regional availability for a private routing preference (us-west)?

We have a legal turnaround next week so would appreciate a simple proposal and the path to an internal approval (if required). Attaching our short summary of requirements.

Thanks,
Peter Lowe
Director of ML Platforms
Equinox Data
Attachment: equinox_requirements_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Peter Lowe <peter@equinoxdata.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-02T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — expected spend profile & commit options

Hi Peter — great outline, thanks.

Short answer: we can support committed per-token pricing with custom SKU banding, but anything materially below published rate card requires internal clearance. I've sketched a first-pass commercial:
- Rate-card baseline: $0.0003 / gen-token; $0.0002 / embed-token (standard hosted tiers)
- Example committed band (>=1B gen tokens): proposed $0.00024 / gen-token (20% off)
- Ramp concession: 15% off month 1–3, then full committed pricing thereafter (contingent on signed commit).

I'll escalate internally to request a one-off volume override for the committed band and confirm capacity/regional routing. Attaching a compact pricing model I use for approvals.

Could you also confirm: required SLA (p95 latency target) and any data residency/KMS needs? That will affect the routing and Dedicated vs Hosted decision.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Exec, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132
Attachment: pricing_model_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-03T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing inquiry — Equinox (requesting pricing clearance)

Team — forwarding Equinox ask and the attached usage summary. Request: approval to offer a custom SKU band with a temporary below-rate-card concession while they ramp. Proposed commercial for approval:
- Commit: 12-month commit, target 1B gen tokens/month average (deal target).
- Commercial ask: 20% off rate-card for committed band (net $0.00024 / gen-token), with a 15% off ramp concession for first 3 months.
- Other asks: standard hosted SLA, us-west routing preference.

Why: strong product fit; potential annualized spend > $4M. Margin check: still positive with our estimated cost per token assuming standard quantized runtime.

Please see attached pricing_model_v2.xlsx for the margin sensitivity. I need an explicit sign-off (or a counter) so I can share a term-sheet with the customer and loop legal.

Attachments: pricing_model_v2.xlsx, equinox_requirements_summary.pdf

Thanks — Stephanie
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-03T11:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing inquiry — Equinox (requesting pricing clearance)

Stephanie —
Appreciate the heads-up and the model. A few quick thoughts:
- I am generally OK to approve a temporary concession to secure the commit, but 20% off on the committed band is at the upper edge. Recommend a two-phased concession: 15% off for months 1–6, then 20% off only if they hit a firm 3-month trailing average >= 1B tokens. That reduces runway risk.
- Require legal to add an overage mechanism and a minimum monthly commitment clause.
- Ask Marissa to confirm blended margin and cash-flow impact; if margin delta > 8% we need a finance sign-off.

If Marissa is good with margin, I give SEP-level clearance to proceed with a term sheet built on the two-phased concession.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing inquiry — Equinox (requesting pricing clearance)

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the pricing_model_v2.xlsx and our internal cost assumptions (attached SOC2 evidence & cost sheet). My position:
- Approve a structured override but narrower than requested: initial concession 10% off for months 1–3, then 15% off months 4–6, and full committed price (15% off) thereafter if usage meets the 1B tokens threshold for two consecutive months.
- Require a minimum monthly commit (50% of target in months 4–6) or step-down pricing if they under-deliver.
- Approve only if legal signs the overage and termination protections.

I'll PDF the margin sensitivity and mark the deal-level maximum discount (15% ongoing) — any further deviation needs CFO approval. Also advise to flag potential Dedicated capacity needs if they actually exceed 1.5B tokens consistently — ops will want notice.

Attachment: SOC2_redwood.pdf (pdf)

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
